subject: SIG: SCIM replay incident + RBAC ownership — evidence & runbook
messages:
From: Kate Lindstrom <kate@midtownhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Midtown Health Security <security@midtownhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request after SCIM replay — timeline + owners

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. We’re in the middle of completing our SIG questionnaire and the SCIM replay incident you remediated last month came up in our risk review. To close our evidence loop we need the following artifacts from Redwood: 

- SCIM delta showing the replayed events and the subsequent reconciliation (CSV preferred)
- A short incident timeline with root-cause notes (1 page)
- RBAC owner roster for the tenant that was affected and proof of owner confirmations
- Example SAML assertion samples that show NameID and groups mapping (redact PII)

Can you confirm you can deliver these items by EOD Friday (7/22)? If there are any gaps in what we asked for, please call them out and propose a short runbook we can use to validate fixes in our environment.

Appreciate it — Kate
Kate Lindstrom
Senior InfoSec Manager, Midtown Health
---
Attachment: incident-summary-request.pdf (PDF)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lindstrom <kate@midtownhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request after SCIM replay — timeline + owners

Hi Kate,

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide all four artifacts. Quick clarifying points: 

- The SCIM delta export will include timestamps and event IDs; we will redact user emails but keep internal identifiers for traceability.
- The RBAC owner roster will include declared owners and the owner-confirmation timestamps (we have completed owner attestation for the affected tenant).
- SAML assertion samples will be synthetic examples sourced from the production assertion logs (no PII).

I’ll coordinate delivery — Priyom will assemble the SCIM delta + RBAC workbook; Laura will review the timeline and the runbook. We’ll upload a small evidence bundle to a secure Drive link and paste the JIRA ticket for your intake.

If you need anything in a specific format (e.g., CSV schema, XLSX columns), say the word and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lindstrom <kate@midtownhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request after SCIM replay — timeline + owners

Kate —

Couple of delivery notes so we’re aligned: 

1) SCIM delta: delivered as a CSV with columns [event_id, timestamp, action, target_type, target_id, actor_id, raw_payload_snippet]. We’ll also provide a short extraction README.
2) RBAC roster: owner list + last attestation date; separate tab for service accounts.
3) SAML assertions: 3 samples (success, missing-groups, expired-session) with headers and decoded attributes.
4) Timeline: short bullet timeline (root cause, mitigation, verification steps) — this will be in the PDF runbook.

We are planning a bundle upload on Monday morning but can accelerate to EOD Friday if you need it sooner. Priyom — can you confirm we can get the first-pass bundle by Friday 7/22 EOD PST?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Compliance Program
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lindstrom <kate@midtownhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle: SCIM delta + RBAC roster + SAML samples (see attachments)

Hi Kate / team,

Per the ask, attached is the initial evidence bundle. High level: 

- scim-delta-20280720.csv — filtered to events for Midtown Health tenant (columns as Laura listed). The CSV contains 1,348 events spanning the replay window and the reconciliation window; PII columns have been redacted and replaced with internal_ids.
- rbac-owner-roster-20280722.xlsx — owner roster and attestation timestamps; service account tab includes delegated owners.
- saml-assertion-samples-20280722.txt — three sanitized assertion samples with attribute mapping notes.
- incident-runbook-v1.2.pdf — short timeline, root cause summary, verification steps for your SOC/SIG reviewer to run a quick smoke test.

Inline notes: 
- Root cause: a throttling bug in an upstream SCIM client caused duplicate PATCH retries; our reconciliation job deduped and reconciled the state within 42 minutes.
- Mitigation: rate-limiting at the SCIM gateway + idempotency token enforcement.
- Verification steps (from runbook): 1) export SCIM state pre/post; 2) run a small user delete/create cycle; 3) validate RBAC owner presence in the roster.

We also created JIRA SEC-7421 for the postmortem and long-term controls; link below. If you need a signed attestation from our CISO, tell us and we’ll route it.

Best,
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence bundle: SCIM delta + RBAC roster + SAML samples (see attachments)

Thanks — received the bundle and started a quick pass. A couple of quick asks before we close the SIG: 

- Can you confirm which RBAC owners are human vs service-account owners (a one-line mapping in the workbook is fine).
- For our verifier, can you add a single-step canary test that we can run from our side against the runbook (one curl + expected response is ideal).

If you can drop a tiny update to the runbook and re-upload, we’ll kick the SIG verification next week. Appreciate the quick turn.

— Kate
